title: Disposable Agent workspace and lean context delivery
objective: Give every Agent exact frozen source through a disposable editable workspace while keeping full source bodies out of the initial Agent Input and preserving SCORE's deterministic review and atomic candidate boundary.
requirements: Each Agent Package binds exactly one target state and every explicitly selected context file as canonical, digest-reproducible workspace inputs; duplicate paths, target/context collisions, non-canonical paths, and path escape are rejected before invocation.

The initial Agent Input contains the objective, allocated requirements, documented declarations, Execution Flows, skills, constraints, target metadata, and context path, purpose, and digest metadata, but contains no complete target or project-context source body and no duplicate target state.

The deterministic review remains complete from persisted Context Items, renders the exact frozen target and context sources, and reports a versioned estimate of initial-input size and available workspace-source size without model selection, fit, or recommendation.

One adapter-neutral module creates a fresh disposable workspace, materializes the exact frozen replace target and explicit context copies, invokes one runtime inside that workspace, extracts only the assigned target, and removes the workspace on every exit.

Agents may read, modify, delete, or create files inside the disposable workspace; every non-target result is ignored and discarded, while absolute paths, traversal, symlink escape, and any access outside the workspace are forbidden.

Candidate extraction still rejects a missing target, non-regular target, symlink target, invalid UTF-8, unchanged replacement, and digest mismatch, and post-admission failures retain only bounded sanitized target evidence.

OpenCode delegates workspace ownership to the shared module and sends only the lean Agent Input to the model while preserving provider selection, session lifecycle, completion checks, observations, and cleanup.

Runner validates and freezes the workspace inputs from the approved Agent Package, never reconstructs them from the live repository, and leaves the real project unchanged until the complete candidate set is atomically applied.

Deterministic tests prove package closure, source-body omission from initial input, complete review rendering, size estimates, context materialization and disposable mutation, path confinement, target-only extraction, failure evidence, cleanup, and OpenCode parity.
